items.question: Which two door-guardian deities are to be worshipped at that door?
premises: The verse names two deities at the door.
items.inference: The ritual directs worship to the trident-bearer and skull-bearer at the doorway.
uncertainties: The exact offering or mantra for these deities is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: At that door, worship the trident-bearer and the skull-bearer.
